verses.original: מֶ֭לֶךְ לֶב־ פַּלְגֵי־ מַ֣יִם בְּיַד־ יְהוָ֑ה יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃ עַֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ leḇ- pal·ḡê- ma·yim bə·yaḏ- Yah·weh yaṭ·ṭen·nū ‘al- kāl- ’ă·šer yaḥ·pōṣ
verses.literal: The king’s heart is a waterway . . . in the hand of the LORD He directs it where . . . - He pleases

verses.original: כָּֽל־ אִ֭ישׁ דֶּרֶךְ־ בְּעֵינָ֑יו יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָֽה׃ וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš de·reḵ- bə·‘ê·nāw yā·šār Yah·weh wə·ṯō·ḵên lib·bō·wṯ
verses.literal: All a man’s ways seem right to him but the LORD weighs the heart

verses.original: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śōh ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·miš·pāṭ niḇ·ḥār Yah·weh miz·zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice

verses.original: רוּם־ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־ לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: rūm- ‘ê·na·yim ū·rə·ḥaḇ- lêḇ nir rə·šā·‘îm ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Haughty eyes and a proud heart the guides of the wicked [are] sin

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־ לְמוֹתָ֑ר אַךְ־ וְכָל־ אָ֝֗ץ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ḥā·rūṣ ’aḵ- lə·mō·w·ṯār ’aḵ- wə·ḵāl ’āṣ lə·maḥ·sō·wr
verses.literal: The plans of the diligent - bring plenty as surely as haste [leads] to poverty

verses.original: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת שָׁ֑קֶר בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן נִ֝דָּ֗ף הֶ֥בֶל מָֽוֶת׃ מְבַקְשֵׁי־
verses.transliteration: pō·‘al ’ō·w·ṣā·rō·wṯ šā·qer bil·šō·wn nid·dāp̄ he·ḇel mā·weṯ mə·ḇaq·šê-
verses.literal: Making a fortune by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist a deadly pursuit

verses.original: שֹׁד־ רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: šōḏ- rə·šā·‘îm yə·ḡō·w·rêm kî mê·’ă·nū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away because they refuse to do what is just

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ וָזָ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃ וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ wā·zār ’îš hă·p̄aḵ·paḵ pā·‘o·lōw wə·zaḵ yā·šār
verses.literal: The way of a guilty man is crooked but the conduct of the innocent is upright

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־ פִּנַּת־ גָּ֑ג חָֽבֶר׃ וּבֵ֥ית מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ lā·še·ḇeṯ ‘al- pin·naṯ- gāḡ ḥā·ḇer ū·ḇêṯ miḏ·yā·nîm mê·’ê·šeṯ
verses.literal: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־ רָ֑ע רֵעֵֽהוּ׃ יֻחַ֖ן לֹא־ בְּעֵינָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš rā·šā‘ ’iw·wə·ṯāh- rā‘ rê·‘ê·hū yu·ḥan lō- bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: The soul of the wicked [man] craves evil his neighbor finds no favor . . . in his eyes

verses.original: לֵ֭ץ בַּעְנָשׁ־ פֶּ֑תִי יֶחְכַּם־ לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל יִקַּח־ דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: lēṣ ba‘·nāš- pe·ṯî yeḥ·kam- lə·ḥā·ḵām ū·ḇə·haś·kîl yiq·qaḥ- dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: When a mocker is punished the simple gain wisdom and when a wise man is instructed he acquires knowledge

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק מַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq maś·kîl lə·ḇêṯ rā·šā‘ mə·sal·lêp̄ rə·šā·‘îm lā·rā‘
verses.literal: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked [and] brings the wicked to ruin

verses.original: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־ דָּ֑ל ה֥וּא גַּֽם־ יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·ṭêm ’ā·zə·nōw miz·za·‘ă·qaṯ- dāl hū gam- yiq·rā wə·lō yê·‘ā·neh
verses.literal: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor he too shall cry out vvv and receive no answer

verses.original: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־ אָ֑ף בַּ֝חֵ֗ק וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַזָּֽה׃ חֵמָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: mat·tān bas·sê·ṯer yiḵ·peh- ’āp̄ ba·ḥêq wə·šō·ḥaḏ ‘az·zāh ḥê·māh
verses.literal: A gift in secret soothes anger and a covert bribe [pacifies] great wrath

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֲשׂ֣וֹת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: miš·pāṭ ‘ă·śō·wṯ śim·ḥāh laṣ·ṣad·dîq ū·mə·ḥit·tāh lə·p̄ō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous but a terror to the workers of iniquity

verses.original: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל יָנֽוּחַ׃ בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām tō·w·‘eh mid·de·reḵ haś·kêl yā·nū·aḥ biq·hal rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: The man who strays from the path of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead

verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה מַ֭חְסוֹר אִ֣ישׁ אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־ וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ śim·ḥāh maḥ·sō·wr ’îš ’ō·hêḇ ya·yin- wā·še·men lō ya·‘ă·šîr
verses.literal: He who loves pleasure will become poor . . . the one who loves wine and oil will never be rich

verses.original: רָשָׁ֑ע כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק בּוֹגֵֽד׃ וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ kō·p̄er laṣ·ṣad·dîq bō·w·ḡêḏ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ yə·šā·rîm
verses.literal: The wicked [become] a ransom for the righteous and the faithless for the upright

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִדְבָּ֑ר מְדוֹנִים וָכָֽעַס׃ מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ še·ḇeṯ bə·’e·reṣ- miḏ·bār mə·ḏō·nīm wā·ḵā·‘as mê·’ê·šeṯ
verses.literal: Better to live in the desert . . . than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife

verses.original: נֶחְמָ֣ד אוֹצָ֤ר׀ וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: neḥ·māḏ ’ō·w·ṣār wā·še·men bin·wêh ḥā·ḵām ū·ḵə·sîl ’ā·ḏām yə·ḇal·lə·‘en·nū
verses.literal: Precious treasures and oil are in the dwelling of the wise but a foolish man consumes them

verses.original: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: rō·ḏêp̄ ṣə·ḏā·qāh wā·ḥā·seḏ yim·ṣā ḥay·yîm ṣə·ḏā·qāh wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life righteousness and honor

verses.original: חָכָ֑ם עָלָ֣ה עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām ‘ā·lāh ‘îr gib·bō·rîm way·yō·reḏ ‘ōz miḇ·ṭe·ḥāh
verses.literal: A wise [man] scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ מִצָּר֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr pîw ū·lə·šō·w·nōw šō·mêr nap̄·šōw miṣ·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress

verses.original: לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: lêṣ šə·mōw zêḏ yā·hîr ‘ō·w·śeh bə·‘eḇ·raṯ zā·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: Mocker is the name of the proud and arrogant man of him who acts with excessive pride

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־ יָדָ֣יו מֵאֲנ֖וּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·waṯ ‘ā·ṣêl tə·mî·ṯen·nū kî- yā·ḏāw mê·’ă·nū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: The craving of the slacker kills him because his hands refuse to work

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm hiṯ·’aw·wāh ṯa·’ă·wāh wə·ṣad·dîq yit·tên wə·lō yaḥ·śōḵ
verses.literal: All day long he covets more but the righteous give without restraint

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃ בְזִמָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ rə·šā·‘îm tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ’ap̄ kî- yə·ḇî·’en·nū ḇə·zim·māh
verses.literal: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable how much more so when brought with ill intent

verses.original: כְּזָבִ֥ים עֵד־ יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁוֹמֵעַ יְדַבֵּֽר׃ לָנֶ֥צַח
verses.transliteration: kə·zā·ḇîm ‘êḏ- yō·ḇêḏ wə·’îš šômēaʿ yə·ḏab·bêr lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: A lying witness will perish but the man who listens [to truth] will speak forever

verses.original: רָשָׁ֣ע אִ֣ישׁ הֵעֵ֬ז בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא׀ יָכִין דְּרָכָיו׃
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ ’îš hê·‘êz bə·p̄ā·nāw wə·yā·šār hū yå̄·ḵīn də·rå̄·ḵå̄w
verses.literal: A wicked man hardens his face but the upright [man] . . . makes his way {sure}

verses.original: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ên ḥāḵ·māh wə·’ên tə·ḇū·nāh wə·’ên ‘ê·ṣāh lə·ne·ḡeḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: [There is] no wisdom no understanding no counsel [that] can prevail against the LORD

verses.original: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃ וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: sūs mū·ḵān lə·yō·wm mil·ḥā·māh hat·tə·šū·‘āh Yah·weh
verses.literal: A horse is prepared for the day of battle but victory [is] of the LORD
